anya (Content): idea: 3-week microseries 'Studio Sprint' -> tutorial, hands-on lab, benchmark deep-dive. Goal: repo stars + signups. quick yes/no?
sam (DevRel): yes. I can do week2 lab + codespace. need a tiny dataset and reproducible prompts.
paul (Growth): metrics: repo clones, demo plays, trial signups. will track via UTMs + webhook.
teri (Design): will make 3 social cards + 15s hero gif. need raw benchmark numbers by Mon.
otto (Analytics): i'll run a small benchmark (p50/p95, $/1M tokens) and surface CSV + tiny viz. ETA Mon EOD.
kaya (Community): i'll recruit 5 champs to run meetups and amplify. also run office hours week2.
anya (Content): publishing plan: launch post + 3 short how-tos weekly + benchmark blog. add short webinar during benchmark week.
sam (DevRel): repo + codespace + one-click hosted demo required. @eng-bot can we get a preview deploy?
eng-bot (automated): preview deploy: https://play.redwood.ai/studio-sprint-preview. branch created: studio-sprint/demo.
paul (Growth): inbound routing: landing -> HubSpot list 'studio-sprint', tag 'oss-refapp'; webhook posts hot leads to #marketing-inbound when score >=7. scoring rules to follow.
anya (Content): sample webhook payload for engineering & sales:
```json
{
  "email":"user@example.com",
  "name":"User",
  "company":"ACME",
  "actions":["reg","demo_play","repo_clone"],
  "engagement_score":"8"
}
```
paul (Growth): final checklist before announce: landing up, repo + demo live, badge assets, webhook tested, benchmark CSV + viz. who will smoke test?
anya (Content): i'll smoke test Tue morning and update here. sync Fri for launch polish. :sparkles:
